The Barber Shop Shrewsbury - Home

top of page

We are now operating on an appointment only basis.

To book in with us you can click HERE (https://the-barber-shop-shrewsbury.nearcut.com/r/LZWX9E)

Alternatively you can call or WhatsApp us on 01743 362638.

Here at The Barber Shop Shrewsbury we pride ourselves on not only giving the best hair cut and beard trim around but also the best barber shop experience there is. With a traditional barber shop environment and relaxed atmosphere you'll be made to feel more than welcome in the shop and whatever your needs are we'll ensure you get the tailor made service you require to guarantee you leave us looking like a true dapper gent.

Whether you're looking for a hair cut, beard trim or just some good conversation, The Barber Shop Shrewsbury is the gents' barber of choice.

​

​

Classic Cut & Beard Trim £20.00

A combination of our classic cut and beard trim using clippers and scissors for that perfect finish

The Barber Shop's premier beard grooming service uses a straight blade razor to define the profile of your beard using hot towels and shaving oil followed by trimming to achieve that perfect finished result

The Barber Shop Shrewsbury - Products

top of page

Quality Grooming Products For The Dapper Gent

"muk™ is an exciting Australian owned professional haircare brand. Founded in Melbourne (Australia) in 2006, muk embarked on a journey to develop a brand that went against the trend of other haircare brands. Their vision was to create a range that not only out performed market leaders, but grabbed the imagination and attention of a saturated market place constantly bombarded with ‘scientific' jargon and magical claims.

​

muk launched its first product ‘Hard muk' in late 2006. With just one product, muk became an overnight success. With its brightly coloured aluminium packaging, cheeky product names and provocative advertising, the brand was on everyone's lips. Ten years later, they have become a market leader in professional haircare in Australia, a favourite with consumers worldwide and international distribution in nineteen countries.

​

With 34 core range products, 5 specialised Argan Oil products and 6 best selling electrical tools, the brand caters to the hair needs of everyone.

​

muk is not just about great products. It's a culture, a lifestyle and an attitude.

And more importantly they are a 100% independent, Australian owned brand."

​
